p31.title: [Lab 3] Define engineering contract and Zen Green UI plan

nodes.body:
Request changes: the Lab 3 contract is technically well structured, but the live Project workflow must match the documented plan before approval. Please move Issue #25 to PR Review and return Issue #26 to Backlog until this contract PR is approved and merged, then update the records to match the live board.

Verification: documentation-only scope; `git diff --check`, internal Markdown links, and FR/AC traceability were checked. No runtime tests are expected at this stage.

Approved. The requested workflow corrections are verified: Issue #25 is in PR Review, Issue #26 is back in Backlog, and the review records accurately describe the correction. The contract remains formally linked to Issue #25 and is ready to merge into lab3-staging.

Reviewed at 7f2a5dd. Please address the two inline findings: stale CSRF-token recovery and preservation of a validated intended route after sign-in. Add regression tests for both, including explicit retry without automatically replaying a mutation.

Verification: all 51 existing client tests passed, and both server and client production builds passed. An isolated additional test reproduced the stale-CSRF retry failure. Database and E2E tests were not rerun locally because Docker was not running; this review does not independently confirm those results.

Workflow reminder: Issue #26 is linked to this PR, but its individual sprint status was still Specified during review. Please move it to PR Review and reply to the review comments once addressed.

Re-reviewed commit 82d7019. Both previous findings are resolved: rejected CSRF tokens are cleared for the next deliberate retry without automatic mutation replay, and validated intended destinations are preserved through login and the initial-password gate. All 60 client tests, the additional CSRF regression test, and both production builds passed. Review replies and Issue #26’s PR Review status are confirmed. No remaining blocking findings. Database/E2E tests were not rerun for this frontend correction.

p33.title: [Lab 3] IT Staff ticket workflow and conversations

nodes.body: Reviewed commit 4196fc9. The implementation covers the staff workflow, role restrictions, concurrency checks, and public/private conversations well. All 344 tests, all 10 browser/E2E tests, and both production builds passed. Issue #27 is correctly linked and in PR Review. One reproduced issue remains in paginated conversation recovery after a lost response, as detailed inline. Please fix it and add regression coverage before approval.

Re-reviewed commit 37d5cd5. The conversation recovery issue is resolved: the latest entries are displayed before retry is enabled, drafts are retained, and no POST is automatically replayed. Regression coverage includes comments, internal notes, failed reads and tab switching. All 74 client tests, the reviewer’s reproduction test, and both builds passed. No remaining blocking findings. Database/E2E tests passed on the preceding commit and were not rerun for this frontend-only correction.

p34.title: feat(lab3): add administrator user management and account safety

nodes.body:
Reviewed commit 88922cb. The account-safety implementation covers authorization, session revocation, version conflicts and concurrent account/ticket operations. All 378 committed tests across 34 files and both production builds passed in the independent review. The full browser run had 11 passes and one failure; the failed Admin lifecycle journey passed on a targeted rerun, exposing the timing-sensitive locator described inline rather than establishing a clean full-suite pass.

Please address the two inline findings: guard dirty account forms against in-app navigation, and make the Admin success-notice assertions unambiguous. An additional isolated regression reproduced the silent loss of unsaved account edits. Issue #28 is formally linked and in PR Review. Tests used isolated databases; development data was untouched. Please reply to both comments after fixing them and request re-review.

Re-reviewed commit c84ad03. Both previous findings are resolved: unsaved account edits are protected during in-app navigation and browser Back/Forward, and success-message assertions are now specific. All 85 client tests, the reviewer’s original regression test, all 13 browser tests, and both production builds passed. No remaining blocking code findings. The full API/unit suite passed on the preceding commit and was not rerun for this frontend-only correction.

p35.title: Verify Lab 3 integration and preserve dialog keyboard focus

nodes.body: Reviewed commit 3d251ce. Integrated tests, dialog keyboard-focus behavior, evidence provenance and coverage mapping were checked. All 389 tests, all 17 browser journeys and both production builds passed independently. All 109 screenshot checksums matched the manifest. No blocking findings. Final-main verification, the final PDF and remaining human inspection are correctly reserved for Issue #30.

p36.title: [Lab 3] Release integrated service desk to main

nodes.body: Reviewed the release integration and supporting documentation. The application and tests remain unchanged from the independently verified PR #35 version. The release report clearly distinguishes staging evidence from pending final-main acceptance, and Issue #30 is correctly linked. Approved for integration into main. After merging, please complete the final-main tests/builds, screenshot provenance, human checks and final submission PDF before marking Issue #30 Done.
